name: rsidc-data-agent
displayName: OBO data agent (Redshift as the user)
description:
Strands agent on AgentCore Runtime. It exchanges the caller's Cognito JWT for an IAM Identity Center token (trusted token issuer) and queries Amazon Redshift as AWSIDC:<user>, so Redshift grants and row-level security apply per user.
Invoke: POST https://bedrock-agentcore.ap-southeast-1.amazonaws.com/runtimes/arn%3Aaws%3Abedrock-agentcore%3Aap-southeast-1%3A123456789012%3Aruntime%2F<obo-runtime-id>/invocations?qualifier=DEFAULT
Auth: Bearer Cognito ID token; Cognito user pool <user-pool-id> (ap-southeast-1); audience = OBO client <obo-client-id>
Owner: Jacky Wu (rsidc PoC)
